# stalwart_o_auth_grant (Resource)

Authorization granted by an account to an OAuth application. Deleting it signs the application out.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `account_id` (String) Identifier for the account that granted the authorization

### Read-Only

- `client_hash` (String) BLAKE3 hash of the client identifier, used to find the authorizations of a client
- `client_id` (String) Identifier of the OAuth client that received the authorization
- `client_kind` (String) How the application was registered. Dynamically registered applications and Client ID Metadata Documents are not verified by an administrator.
- `client_name` (String) Name of the application, as provided by the client or its administrator
- `created_at` (String) Date the authorization was granted
- `generation` (Number) Refresh token generation, used to detect reuse of superseded refresh tokens
- `id` (String) Server-assigned identifier.
- `last_used_at` (String) Date the application last renewed its access
- `pending` (Boolean) Whether the latest refresh token has not yet been used by the application
- `remote_ip` (String) IP address from which the authorization was granted
- `scopes` (Set of String) Services the application was given access to. First-party applications have full access to the account.
